title: AINS message envelope v1
description: Documentation only. The authoritative validator is scripts/ains_runtime/contracts.py (stdlib, no jsonschema dependency); where this document and the code disagree, the code wins and this file is a bug. Every message type shares this envelope; `body` is type-specific. Strings must not contain the value of any environment variable whose name contains KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD or AUTH as a whole underscore-delimited segment (or as the whole name, case-insensitive), where the segment may have digits glued to the keyword inside it (KEY2, 2KEY, SECRET1; values of 8+ chars); such a message is rejected (not expressible in JSON Schema).

schema.description: ains.<type>/v<N>. Any version this runtime does not list in SCHEMA_VERSIONS is rejected.

message_id.description: Unique per payload. Same id + same payload returns the stored receipt; same id + different payload is a conflict.

revision.description: A new work item starts at 1; each new experiment-request for the same work must be strictly newer. Other messages must carry the work's current revision.

reply_to.description: Optional; required for receipts and clarification answers.

artifact_ref.description: A digest is required unless provisional is true. A local path is a location, never an identity; the digest is the identity.
